idea-plugin.name: Privacy Manifest Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Checks PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and your C#, Dart, JS, Swift and Kotlin source for Apple required-reason APIs, and decodes all 17 reason codes back to the category they belong to.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Privacy Manifest Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 48 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/privacy-manifest-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/privacy-manifest-lint

action.text: Privacy Manifest Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Privacy Manifest Lint on the file in the editor
